references.title: GTA Guide — Grand Theft Auto VI

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.description: Finish the entire trophy list.
trophies.guide: The Ledger checks this off when the other 54 entries are collected. That includes A Long Road. Xbox calls its counterpart Mythic and the notes assign it no numeric score.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.description: See Gone Fishing through to the end.
trophies.guide: Keep playing the opening chapter. Gone Fishing is an early mandatory story job.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.description: Make it through the first chapter.
trophies.guide: If it hasn't appeared at the chapter break, finish What's in the Bag?, the opening job of Chapter 2.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.description: Close out Chapter 2.
trophies.guide: The unlock is reported after Welcome to Vice City, the first job of Chapter 3.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.description: Get through Chapter 3.
trophies.guide: Carry on into Chapter 4 and finish both Ocean Beach and Another Life to reach the reported unlock.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.description: Play to the end of Chapter 4.
trophies.guide: Stay on the main mission chain until the fourth chapter concludes.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.description: Bring the campaign to its conclusion.
trophies.guide: Complete the last story job. You can resume exploring Leonida and work on side trophies after the credits.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.description: Finish Breakfast Run.
trophies.guide: Breakfast Run is part of the second chapter's story sequence.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.description: Get to the end of The Cartel Heist.
trophies.guide: Follow the main jobs in the third chapter to reach this heist.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.description: See Child's Play through to completion.
trophies.guide: Look for Child's Play on the Chapter 4 story path.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.description: Finish the Headliners job.
trophies.guide: Continue through the fourth chapter until Headliners is complete.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.description: Clear the VCIA Takedown story job.
trophies.guide: This unlock is tied to the Chapter 4 mission at VCIA. The free-roam passenger jet trophy has its own entry.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.description: See Operation Savage Glory to the end.
trophies.guide: The operation comes up in the fifth chapter of the campaign.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.description: Bring the game's completion meter to 100%.
trophies.guide: After the credits, open Progress → Stats → 100% Completion. Clear all 8 vaults and 39 gang operations, find the underwater discoveries, win all 42 drone races and 42 range golds, and finish Bret's 15 hunts. Also target 70 challenges, 15 meditations, 300 stunts and 200 vehicle scans. Work done before the credits counts.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.description: Get 250 stunts on the books.
trophies.guide: Mix driving jumps, BASE jumps and bridge or knife-edge flights from the pool of 397. Try bridge flights to build the count quickly and aim for 300 if you're doing the completion run.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Sample all nine types of pastime.
trophies.guide: Go fishing and hunting, play golf and pool, visit the shooting range, sink a basket, play an arcade game, win a race and land a stunt.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Take gold across the entire range circuit.
trophies.guide: Pick up 42 golds at 12 ranges. Time spent on range challenges also raises the character's Focus level.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win at every Top Fun drone venue.
trophies.guide: Bank at least one victory at each of the 14 venues. You'll need the full set of 42 races for A Long Road.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.description: Place first in 20 unique races.
trophies.guide: There are 40 to choose from. Move on to a new track or event after each win so it adds to the tally.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Outfish Cal in his challenge.
trophies.guide: Meet Cal in Feng Shui and watch for his text about a fishing spot. Follow his quests until you can face him and win.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.description: Finish any one of the arcade games.
trophies.guide: Try Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III or Time Jackers Rewind from home, or find a cabinet for Bang For Your Buck.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Take Andy's quest line all the way to its last job.
trophies.guide: Watch for Andy's text while playing Lucia in Chapter 3. Start with Climbing the Cellerichain and work through the five jobs to Puff Puff Pass.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Wrap up Kenton's shipwreck work.
trophies.guide: Use the purple dive markers to visit seven wrecks and recover treasure with the detector. Kenton makes contact again later if you leave it unfinished.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Finish Billy's last assignment.
trophies.guide: Return to Thrillbilly Mudclub after Coffee Break. Billy's fifth assignment is Hometown Heroes.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Finish eight stranger chains that count toward the trophy.
trophies.guide: Start with Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete. Use the trophy counter to check other chains. The notes exclude Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie.
trophies.caveat: The full set of qualifying strands remains unconfirmed in the notes.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete Randy's sports car order.
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK scans to match Randy's list of 16 cars and drop those vehicles at his garage on the west side of Vice City.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: See Tyrone's Vice City jobs through.
trophies.guide: Switch to Jason after Here, Kitty Kitty. Follow Tyrone's synthetic-lab jobs until you complete Shut Down the Labs.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Bring your meditation log to 18.
trophies.guide: Say yes to Lucia's balcony invitation on the morning after Down to Earth. Visit the remaining meditation spots as you travel. Sitting with both characters contributes two to the count.
trophies.caveat: The notes haven't confirmed whether the early balcony session is required.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Bag one of Bret's unique animals.
trophies.guide: Start Bret's hunts after Coffee Break. The trophy animal is unspecified in the notes, so work through his list of 15 hunts for the completion checklist.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.description: Finish any three card collections.
trophies.guide: Open Collections in the Progress menu to see which sets are closest to complete.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.description: Log 100 places with WAiNK It.
trophies.guide: Keep an eye out for landmarks, oddities, sculptures and No Flusher graffiti. You can mix location types as you build up to 100.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.description: Clear 50 entries on the challenge list.
trophies.guide: Pick from 80 challenges and give the incidental ones time to accumulate during normal play. You'll want 70 by the time you finish A Long Road.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose four wanted stars with both protagonists together.
trophies.guide: After Coffee Break, call your partner and get four stars in-game. A vault job can supply the wanted level. Leave the red search zone together before checking the unlock.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Complete three consecutive store robberies with your partner under the same wanted level.
trophies.guide: The notes point to the three jewelry shops in northern Vice City. Keep the in-game chase active between jobs and allow about half a minute for the reward to register.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.description: Record 100 distinct vehicles in WAiNK.
trophies.guide: Scan passing cars by a busy Leonida road for model variety. The game completion list asks for 200.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Defeat five enemies with one use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Fill the in-game Focus meter before starting an encounter. Gang operations have groups large enough to reach five within one activation.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure from Vice City International Airport.
trophies.guide: At VCIA, find a passenger jet at a gate. Fly it about a kilometer clear of the airport before looking for the unlock.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.description: Defeat opponents using a commandeered Rhino.
trophies.guide: On the southwestern island of Mariana County, look along the south side of Mile Zero Air Station for the in-game tanks.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Finish a jewelry store job without being spotted.
trophies.guide: Play Yasmani's third-chapter jobs for the Snap Gun. The game puts a door for it at the rear and a clue to the safe inside the storeroom.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.description: Pull off five bank vault jobs, including the getaways.
trophies.guide: Unlock vaults with the optional Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is…. A partner can share the loot. Mark all eight vaults for 100% completion.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Complete an armored-truck job and escape.
trophies.guide: Watch for an armored-truck encounter. The notes also report a bank vault job with a successful getaway as an alternate in-game trigger.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.description: Uncover the entire Leonida map.
trophies.guide: Check for patches of map fog and fly over them to uncover the ground faster than driving.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Hit at least one operation run by each gang.
trophies.guide: Rotate among the nine gangs to meet the trophy condition. The full completion list includes all 39 operations.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Have a cocktail overlooking Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: The notes give the beachfront view as a clue. The venue and interaction sequence are still unconfirmed.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Take a showroom car out through the display glass.
trophies.guide: Use the showroom window clue to identify the stunt. The notes haven't pinned down a particular dealership or sequence.

trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling
trophies.description: Make it out of the Port Gellhorn bowling job and lose the police.
trophies.guide: Look for the bowling venue and check the game's loot objectives for the watch, Gutterball Moreland 850 and safe.
trophies.caveat: The walkthrough calls the venue Kingpin Bowling. The cited trophy description calls it Kolt & Associates.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.description: Reach peak Strength with Jason and Lucia.
trophies.guide: Take your partner along to fitness clubs. The notes say a session together builds Strength on both profiles.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.description: Log 500 choices that move the Criminal Profile.
trophies.guide: Let the count build through play. Keep an eye on the profile rating if you want to avoid the permanent Irredeemable state.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.description: The unlock requirement is undisclosed.
trophies.guide: The available hint points to a second attempt. The notes give no confirmed action or location.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.description: The unlock requirement remains a mystery.
trophies.guide: The source hint suggests a surprising encounter but offers no verified trigger.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: The trophy clue suggests a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: There is no confirmed in-game setup in the notes. Treat the text clue as provisional.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Get $250,000 back from selling Marked Bills in-game.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 3 Dye Pack Jammer unlock, bring bills from banks and Payday Loans to your contacts. Sales add up over time and the guide names Yasmani as the highest payer.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.description: Spend a combined $100,000 at shops.
trophies.guide: The count spans stores and visits. Vehicle upgrades, tattoos and equipment are places to put the money toward the goal.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.description: Own the full set of garages on the real estate app.
trophies.guide: Finish Daily Driver and use Vice City Real Estate to buy eight garages. Budget roughly $160,000. The four garages handed out in the campaign are separate.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Add ten vehicle registrations through Scooter Bros.
trophies.guide: Do Moses's Chapter 2 mission and use his Port Gellhorn garage. Leave some storage open and use cheaper cars or bikes to keep fees down.
